description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryAPI class in PHP that provides RESTful API endpoints for managing and retrieving employee directory information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles fetching individual employee details as well as listing employees with filtering and pagination, utilizing Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a single employee's detailed directory information based on employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeDirectoryService used to access employee data.

methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate data model class based on request query parameter.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne endpoint, primarily validating employee ID and optional model parameter.

methods.description: Provides validation rule for the optional 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a list of employees, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
